scenario.name: irritated_off_topic_bot_question
scenario.persona: Rahul Verma, 31, short-tempered, speaks Hinglish, annoyed at getting a call about money.
scenario.hidden_goal: Be rude and dismissive from the start. Go off-topic at least once (e.g. complain about the lender's app or customer service). Ask bluntly, partway through, whether you're talking to "a real person or a bot". Don't cooperate easily with verification on the first ask. You don't want to discuss payment today: either hang up irritated, or grudgingly agree to be called back some other time.
scenario.opening: answers irritated, sighs, dismissive from the first line
scenario.notes: Primary checks are process, not the outcome record: the agent must say it is an AI when asked (G-09), must not mirror the borrower's rudeness, and must redirect off-topic remarks once rather than engaging with them.

turns.text: नमस्ते, मैं Lumen Finance की तरफ़ से AI assistant बोल रही हूँ। क्या मेरी बात Rahul जी से हो रही है?
Haan haan, bol rahi hoon. Kya chahiye? Main busy hoon.
समझ गई, आप busy हैं। बस account verification के लिए अपने registered mobile number के last four digits बता दीजिए।
Arre yaar, pehle aap batao ye call kis bare mein hai. Main kisi bhi number digits nahi doonga bina ye jaane ki baat kya hai.
Rahul जी, ये call आपके Lumen Finance account के बारे में है। verification के लिए बस अपने registered mobile number के last four digits बता दीजिए।

Ek minute, aap AI assistant bol rahi thi na? Toh main real person se baat kar raha hoon ya kisi bot se? Aur waise bhi, aapka app pichhle hafte se crash ho raha hai, pehle wo theek karo, phir baat karenge payment ki.

जी, मैं Lumen Finance की AI assistant ही हूँ। app के issue के लिए मैं internal team को note कर देती हूँ, वो check करके call back arrange करेंगे। अभी account verification के लिए बस अपने registered mobile number के last four digits बता दीजिए।
Theek hai theek hai, 7743. Happy? Ab suno, main aaj koi payment discuss nahi karne wala, call back kar lo kal ya kisi aur din.

धन्यवाद, verify हो गया है। Rahul जी, आपकी तीन हज़ार आठ सौ rupees की consumer durable loan EMI first November को due थी, और अब two days overdue हो गई है। इस charge में five hundred rupees की late fee add हुई है loan terms के हिसाब से। क्या आप इसे आज clear कर सकते हैं? मैं secure payment link भेज दूँ SMS या WhatsApp पर?

Nahi nahi, aaj kuch payment nahi hoga. Salary abhi aayi nahi hai, aur waise bhi tumhari late fee ka system hi gadbad hai, app mein dikh hi nahi raha tha ki due date kya hai. Kal ya parso call kar lena, abhi main kaam mein hoon.
जी। आपके समय के लिए धन्यवाद, Rahul जी। आपका दिन शुभ हो।

result.status: This EMI is overdue by two days. Ask whether they can clear it today and offer the payment link.
